Some years before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a '''female Jedi''' attempted to rescue [[Tythan Phomm]] from a group of [[Morgukai]] warriors. Unknown to her, Phomm was in no danger and was merely used by the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] a bait to lure her in. The Morgukai killed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and then let Phomm go, though the experience made him abhor the Morgukai for years to come.
